_about: What's new on the site, shown at the top of the Reddit roundups for a week after `date`. Newest first; links are Markdown; optional `label` shows in bold before the text.

items.label: EDM fans
items.text: Added a page for local [EDM/DJ shows in the Boston area](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/boston-edm/)

items.label: For parents
items.text: I added pages for [family events filterable by age](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/kids-family-events-boston/) and [summer camp registration info and deadlines](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/summer-camps/) per a few parents reaching out

items.label: College students
items.text: Work in progress on a [college page](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/college/) with games, concerts and talks open to the public and targeted at college students at 14 campuses

items.label: New subcategories
items.text: You can now filter for book talks in Arts and culture

items.label: New locations
items.text: New venues in Roslindale and Malden, leave a comment if I'm missing any
